facts.text: I am planning to attend another music festival next weekend.
I saw an indie band last weekend.
I saw a band that reminded me of The Cure and Depeche Mode.
The band I saw was upbeat and energetic.
I bumped into a guy named Alex at the festival.
Alex and I both loved 80s music.
I am thinking of reaching out to Alex.
I want to grab coffee with Alex to discuss more 80s music.
I want to ask Alex about his favorite 80s movies.
I recently bumped into a freelance writer named Sarah at a coffee shop a few weeks ago.
I had a nice chance conversation with Sarah.
I am thinking of asking Sarah about her novel and how the progress is going.
I bumped into Sarah three weeks ago at the train station.
Sarah and I exchanged numbers three weeks ago.
I am looking for book recommendations.
I am looking for book recommendations similar to my favorite author.
I recently met a woman named Rachel at a bookstore.
Rachel recommended some similar books to me.
I think I will go back to the store to discuss the books Rachel and I have both read.
